title: Shiraishi An — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: An's birthday
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is everyone ready?

rows.Speaker: Rin, Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're ready too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright then. I'll light the candles.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Blow them all out, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! You got it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone!
*Blow*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, An♪
Okay, cake time! C'mon, let's cut it up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Someone's a little too eager for a slice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Says the one who's already got a fork in his hand.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oops. You got me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha! I'm just as excited as you are. This rum raisin pound cake looks so yummy, I can barely sit still!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you, An. Truthfully, I think a more typical birthday cake would've been better though...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The candles don't really match, do they?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's nothing! I couldn't be happier. This thing's stuffed with rum-soaked raisins!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that. Makes me feel better knowing that the birthday girl approves.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, I used the leftover ingredients to make rum raisin ice cream, so feel free to have some for dessert.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hold on, doesn't the pound cake also count as a dessert?

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright then, I'll cut the cake. There's plenty of food and snacks to go around, so don't hold back, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okey dokey! Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO! Please make sure to cut all the slices the same size except for An's piece!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yeah! An's the birthday girl, so she can get the biggest piece♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure? Then a big slice for me please, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright. Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But... Are you gonna be okay eating that much?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Didn't you say you were going to have another celebration with your other friends?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I did, but there's still loads of time until then, so it's all good!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well yes, but perhaps don't overdo it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If she stuffs herself until she can't move, we can just leave her behind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey! You'd seriously just up and leave without the birthday girl?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Don't worry, An. I'd never leave you behind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
K-Koohaanee...!
You seriously are the best!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, An.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's see... So we're supposed to meet up around here, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Oh, there they are.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey Mizuki! Hello Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nice to see you all again. Thank you for going out of your way to invite me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not a problem at all! Thank you for coming, even though you're so busy with art studies!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't know about “busy”...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ow!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah...good ol' sibling affection.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So true!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, you were the one who organized everything, right, Mizuki? Thank you for booking the cafe and planning all of this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, yeah... Let's talk about that more later♪ We gotta start heading over to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right. We've got people waiting for us over there, don't we!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wouldn't want to make them wait, so let's—
Halt! You there...it is your birthday today, is it not?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh! Look who it is!

rows.Speaker: Happy B'Day Green
rows.Line: “P-Providing negative air ionization and comforting songs! Happy B'Day Green!”

rows.Speaker: Happy B'Day Purple
rows.Line: “Bringing you an explosive celebration and performance! Happy B'Day Purple!”

rows.Speaker: Happy B'Day Orange
rows.Line: “Blazing with celebrative energy that can rival the sun! Happy B'Day Orange!”

rows.Speaker: Happy B'Day Orange
rows.Line: “And together we're...”

rows.Speaker: Happy B'Day Rangers
rows.Line: “The celebration squad, Happy B'Day Rangers!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! You three are the best♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: U-Umm... What are you all doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Isn't it obvious? We are here to give you a surprise show! You were on the way to meet us at the cafe, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that was all part of the surprise! How was it? I'm sure you found yourself astounded.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well it sure was different to what I was told... I was really surprised to see you all suddenly start dancing at a place like this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Surprised? Are you sure you don't mean put off?
See? This is why I was against it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But Emu had so kindly come up with this idea for us. I didn't want her efforts to go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I heard that you were all coming, but I didn't know that you'd be putting on a surprise show for us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah!
I was so surprised that I couldn't react properly!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Liar. You cringed like any regular person would.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: N-No I didn't!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, we should be getting a move on. We're also attracting a lot of attention right now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good idea! Alright then, to the cafe we go♪
